reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that connects GPT model access to a ChatGPT account through the local Codex app-server, including OAuth login, model discovery, and profile registration.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 Codex app-server 将 ChatGPT 账户中的 GPT 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 OAuth 登录、模型发现和配置文件注册。
summaries.en: Connects GPT models from a ChatGPT account to DeepSeek Harness through the local Codex app-server, with OAuth sign-in, model discovery, and profile registration.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to GPT models through the local Codex app-server
Initiates ChatGPT OAuth sign-in and uses Codex-managed credential storage and token refresh
Registers or removes the plugin across DeepSeek Harness profiles
Provides the signed-in account's available models to the Harness model picker
